title: Forbidden Smelter
description: The furnace can now smelt, mace, blaze rods, eyes of ender, etc.
body:
![The icon for the datapack](https://i.imgur.com/6J6BsaY.png)
The forbidden furnace datapack adds an feature where you can smelt
a mace, blaze rod, diamonds, etc. I'll be testing this datapack for
3 days to check for any bugs, things that aren't working, etc.


### ► Smelting Ingredients.
  - smelt stick = mace.
  - smelt dirt = diamonds.
  - smelt copper ingot = netherite ingot.
  - smelt gunpowder = blaze rod.
  - smelt coal = eyes of ender.
